messages:
Amrita Rao: FYI ClearWave ACH bounced (R01). Invoice C-4091 is 37 days overdue for $12,430. They emailed asking for a short payment plan and to waive the $50 late fee.
Luca Martel: Pulled ledger — steady usage historically, just a slow month. Any promises from sales?
Janelle Kim: No promises logged. We sent 2 dunning emails and left voicemail. Customer replied asking if we could waive the fee if they pay soon.
Mateo Alvarez: R01 suggests bad account number/closed account. CC capture now is safest. Recommend CC token for partial capture.
Amrita Rao: Option A: 7-day full pay with $50 waiver. Option B: 2-installments (50/50) with CC auth for first and ACH retry for second but keep fee. Which to offer?
Priya Singh: Legal OK to waive once if documented. Need written acceptance and clause that waiver void if chargeback occurs within 90 days. Signed agreement required for split.
Luca Martel: Offer A first (simpler). If they ask split, require signed plan + CC auth. I'll draft wording.
Janelle Kim: I'll message them via Intercom with the offer, include payment link and deadline, copy billing@redwood.
CollectionsBot: HOLD: Customer reply window open until 2025-09-07T15:00Z.
Amrita Rao: If no reply by 7 days escalate on day 10 to senior collections. Update invoice record with conditional waiver note.
Janelle Kim: Message sent to ClearWave with link https://payments.redwood/inv/C-4091. Waiting reply.
Amrita Rao: Thanks team. Will update ledger once payment or signed plan received.
